description: This file defines the Coroutine class in the GuzzleHttpomise namespace, implementing promise-based asynchronous control flow using generators. It provides methods to create, manage, and control coroutines that yield promises, facilitating sequential async operations.

classes.name: Coroutine
classes.description: Implements a promise that manages a generator-based coroutine, allowing asynchronous code to be written in a sequential style.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new Coroutine instance wrapping a generator function.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Attaches fulfillment and rejection handlers to the promise.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Attaches a rejection handler to the promise.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for the promise to settle and returns its value.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the promise.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the promise with a given value.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the promise with a given reason.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the ongoing coroutine and its associated promise.

methods.name: nextCoroutine
methods.description: Advances the generator with a yielded promise or value.

methods.name: _handleSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful resolution of a yielded promise, sending the value back into the generator.

methods.name: _handleFailure
methods.description: Handles failure of a yielded promise, throwing an exception into the generator.
